messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning to enable signal-7b-tiling in catalog at 23:00 PDT change window. TL;DR: small percent canary -> observe latency and fallback ordering. @alex can you confirm obs dashboards?

alex: On it. I've added a per-variant latency panel and an end-to-end success rate. Will watch the 99th pct and kv cache hitrate.

sara: Are we pinning traffic anywhere? I think we should pin critical routes (embed, search) to stable-6b during canary.

maya: Yes — plan: 5% traffic to signal-7b-tiling for 30 min, no direct routing for high-SLA routes. fallback ladder: signal-7b-tiling -> signal-7b-quant -> stable-6b. Rollback triggers: 5% increase in 99th latency or 3% regression in quality evals.

alex: Sounds good. I'll create the rollout config in catalog and add a temporary TTL on fallback priority of 15m.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled enable job queued: enable model signal-7b-tiling at 2024-09-12T23:00Z (change window). Command: /catalog enable signal-7b-tiling --canary 5% --duration 30m --fallback 'signal-7b-tiling,signal-7b-quant,stable-6b'

kevin: Quick ops note: watch memgrowth on nimbus nodes; tiling can spike allocs during warmup. If OOM rate > 1% roll back immediately.

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert rule created: nimbus.mem.oom_rate > 0.01 for 5m -> #incidents notify.

sara: :thumbsup: can we add a soft pin for search routes? I'll add to the rollout config.

maya: Added soft pin. Also leaving a manual rollback button in the deploybot workflow. If someone hits it, deploybot will run `/catalog rollback signal-7b-tiling --to stable-6b --note 'manual rollback'`

alex: I'll be watching logs and setting traces. If I see KV cache hit drop by >10% for 10m, I'll call rollback.

maya: Thanks. Final: post-deploy check at +10m and +25m in #eng-releases. If all green after 30m we can scale to 20% tomorrow.

deploybot: deploybot: enable job started at 2024-09-12T23:00:05Z. Step 1/3: reserve slots -> OK. Step 2/3: push variant mapping -> OK. Step 3/3: start canary traffic -> 5% routed.

maya: Noted. ping me if anything smells off. /cc @sara @alex @kevin
